payload.body: roadmap.ticket-grilling-self-resolved fires when an agent resolves its own grilling question under governance.product: human without citing a human-attributed source. Because the journal is append-only, an already-resolved ticket can never gain a --source; the append-only-native remedy shipped instead: a LATER human-attributed note carrying data ticket=<id> counts as post-hoc ratification and clears the warning (symmetric with DD6). The underlying rule Jim set during the PR #27 review is that AFK self-resolution should run as a cross-agent grill, preferably cross-vendor (codex<->claude, claude<->cursor), with the agents working the question together — not one agent answering itself.
